name: Onna no Ko Shoukougun
source:
Something worth watching over and nurturing exists here.
The boyish little girl you met at the park, awakens to her inner 'femininity' via the act of exhibition...
Depending on your choices, there are 3 different happy endings.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ199738.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这里有值得守护与培养的东西。

你在公园遇见的假小子女孩，通过走光行为唤醒内心的“女性气质”。

根据你的选择，有3种不同的幸福结局。
